replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states dashboards query warehouse with analyst credentials; concrete privilege inheritance by viewers."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Link-shared dashboards with no viewer entitlement check; leaked URL exposes salary/health data."},{"id":"T3","keep":false,"reason":"Same attack and harm as T2: link holders reading salary/health rows without per-viewer checks.","duplicateOf":"T2"},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Non-expiring company-wide links trigger privileged warehouse queries; concrete cost/compute exhaustion attack."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Design states links never expire; leavers/role-changers retaining access is a distinct attack."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Shared-credential queries break attribution; distinct harm of untraceable health-data access."}]}
